title: Usage Limit Reported
description: A provider pool reports a usage limit or an outage for an attempt.

attempt_id.description: The attempt that hit the limit.

pool.description: The usage pool of the persona's provider, as named in the worker profile.

reset_at.description: Optional. When the pool resets, UTC. Absent when the provider gives no reset time (for example an outage): fleetd then waits until the pool probe reports ok (orchestrator, D15).
